content: APPL2 DCC-interacting protein 13-beta is a protein in humans that is encoded by the APPL2 gene. Model organisms have been utilized to investigate the function of the APPL2 protein. A conditional knockout mouse line, named Appl2tm1a(KOMP)Wtsi, was developed as part of the International Knockout Mouse Consortium program. This program is a high-throughput mutagenesis initiative aimed at creating and distributing animal models of human diseases to researchers worldwide. The mouse line was generated at the Wellcome Trust Sanger Institute. Both male and female mice from this line underwent a standardized phenotypic screening process to assess the effects of the gene deletion. A total of 23 different tests were conducted on these mutant mice. However, no significant abnormalities were detected in any of the tests performed.
